title: Organizational claims do not match FedRAMP Marketplace
author: LPT00-ctrl
body: I have seen websites where organizations put the FedRAMP logo on their website front page with the words "FedRAMP Compliant" below the logo, yet when I look on the FedRAMP Marketplace, I do not see the organization listed. Is that allowed? It seems somewhat misleading to me.

comments.author: severinsendaniel88-prog
comments.body:
> I have seen websites where organizations put the FedRAMP logo on their website front page with the words "FedRAMP Compliant" below the logo, yet when I look on the FedRAMP Marketplace, I do not see the organization listed. Is that allowed? It seems somewhat misleading to me.
